about: Cross-skill edges for the DT, IE and ER lanes (docs/design/dbt-modules-plan.md C4). Rows from the PRD Index §7b (n = its row number) plus module-PRD hand-offs (n = null, source named). kind: exit (a SkillExit), inline (EMBEDS_SKILL, plan C3c), data (a shared object, not an exit), gate. Each target: tool id and state: built (a live exit exists), planned (written as a planned exit), or the batch that builds it. tests/module-edges.test.mjs checks the rows against skills.json for every skill on the runtime.
